shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find .agents -type f | head -100 && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; grep -n -i -B2 -A40 "markdown\|editor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

sed -n 348,380p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40

npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor peerDependenciesMeta 2>&1 | head -40; npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor 2>&1 | tail -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 version --json | tr -d '[]," ' | grep . | tail -25); do echo "$v $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit)"; done 2>&1 | tail -25

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 markdown-it@^13 @diplodoc/transform@^4.43.0 @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension katex@^0.16.9 2>&1 | tail -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; ls build/docs/guides; grep -n -i "required setup\|import '" README.md | head -30

cat build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; sed -n 1,80p build/docs/guides/how-to-add-preview.md; grep -rn "initial\|markup\|wysiwyg\|splitMode\|initialEditorMode" build/cjs/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts | head -30

ls build; grep -rn "initialEditorMode\|initialSplitModeEnabled\|'change'\|'submit'\|'cancel'" build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts build/esm/bundle/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -n "\"main\"\|\"module\"\|\"types\"\|\"exports\"" -A6 package.json | head -30; grep -n "styles\|css" README.md | head

grep -n "styles.css\|\"\./" package.json | head -20; grep -rln "initialEditorMode" build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; grep -rn "ChangeEvent\|EditorEvents\|change:\|\"change\"\|'change'" build/esm/bundle/Editor.d.ts build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts | head; grep -rn "initialToolbarVisible\|stickyToolbar\|settingsVisible" build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts | head

cat build/esm/bundle/events.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts; grep -n "initialEditorMode\|initialSplitModeEnabled\|initialToolbarVisible\|md?:\|allowHTML" -r build/esm/bundle/Editor.d.ts build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; grep -n "styles" package.json; ls build/*.css

sed -n 1,80p build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; grep -n "initialEditorMode\|initialSplitModeEnabled\|initialToolbarVisible\|allowHTML\|md?" -r build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "getValue\|isEmpty\|clear\|replace" build/esm/bundle/Editor.d.ts | head
sed -n 100,200p build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts; cat build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "initial" build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts | head

grep -n "MarkdownEditorInitialOptions = " -A25 build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts; grep -n "interface CommonEditor" -A25 build/esm/common/*.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "MarkdownEditorMdOptions = " -A12 build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Button Flex Text Card 2>&1 | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Button Flex Text Card 2>&1 | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n "onUpdate\|label\|placeholder\|size\|validationState\|errorMessage" build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts build/esm/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -n "gap\|direction" build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts build/esm/components/layout/Flex/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -20
cat .gitignore; git status --short
rm -rf dist && git status --short
